article.title: Taboola完成收購Dianomi，擴充金融媒體廣告版位
article.summary: Taboola宣布完成收購Dianomi，後者的媒體網絡涵蓋商業、金融及生活內容。
highlights: 公司描述的媒體合作例子包括Reuters及CNN Business。
Taboola稱將與其Realize平台結合，公告未列逐項開放日期。
article.why: 金融廣告團隊可重新核對版位環境及合規審閱流程。
article.next_step: 向平台索取可用版位、地區及內容分類，再按客戶規範挑選測試名單。
article.detail: Taboola公布已完成收購Dianomi，並指後者的網絡連接金融廣告主和商業、金融及生活出版商。Taboola描述了與Realize結合的方向，公告未交代每個帳戶可取得的版位及日期。媒體團隊可先按合規要求查核內容環境、地區、價格及報表分類。
article.title_en: Taboola completes Dianomi acquisition, adding a finance-focused publisher network
article.summary_en: Taboola announced that it completed its acquisition of Dianomi, whose network covers business, finance and lifestyle content.
highlights_en: The company named Reuters and CNN Business among publisher examples.
Taboola described combining the network with Realize, with no feature-by-feature release dates in the notice.
article.why_en: Financial advertisers can revisit placement context and approval workflows.
article.next_step_en: Ask for placements, markets and content categories, then shortlist a test using client requirements.
article.detail_en: Taboola says it completed the acquisition of Dianomi, whose network connects financial advertisers with business, finance and lifestyle publishers. Taboola described combining the network with Realize. Inventory access and dates were not specified per account. Media teams can check content context, markets, pricing and reporting against compliance requirements.
